time_convention.true_state: after all events dated <= t incl. tick t0, before any decision at t
time_convention.action: applied at t on each system's start state, before tick t0+1
time_convention.rollout_start: tick t0+1, no replay of events <= t

confirmation.population: REF2_CONF (200 + 24x4 instants), generated after the design freeze, never used for tuning

M_pub.definition: L(best of {L1-v2,L2-v2,L2c-v2}) - L(L4-v2), nats/item, R1 aggregation over families validated on TUNE (addendum-2 rule), best ref re-chosen per replicate

decision.definition: U(best public competitor) - U(L4-N-v2 planner), U units, per instant then mean
decision.best_public_competitor: chosen on TUNE among {rule v2, C_param-v2, C_pub_snap-v2, L4-v2 planner} by a procedure frozen at design freeze
decision.comparable: same actions, constraints, objective, M, choice keys, OBJ-LEX-1

reported_separately: privileged information value = U(best public) - U(C_full-v2)
gain from public history = U(best public) - U(L4-N-v2)

freeze_G0_v2: only after a successful independent confirmation

fail_verdict.label: PAS_DE_MARGE_IDENTIFIABLE_A_CETTE_ECHELLE
fail_verdict.scope: the tested setup only, not a general impossibility
